exposure: Medical termination of pregnancy (MTP) by surgical method
cohort: A 24-year fourth gravida with a history of one dilatation and curettage and two cesarean sections.
finding: This case illustrates that undiagnosed cesarean scar pregnancy, especially when proceeding with medical termination without prior imaging, can lead to life-threatening complications like hemorrhagic shock and DIC.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean sections are a risk factor for cesarean scar pregnancy, necessitating mandatory ultrasonography before any termination of pregnancy to identify the implantation site.
gest_age: 14 weeks of pregnancy (at the time of MTP)
